name: selaenium/selenium-webdriver
description: Selenium WebDriver for PHP over the shared pure-Aether engine (libselenium_core), reached through ext-ffi. Carries no protocol logic.

scripts-descriptions.fetch-engine: Download + cache the prebuilt engine (libselenium_core) for this platform from GitHub releases; no Aether toolchain needed. Pass -- --tag=vX.Y.Z / --force.
